reference.pathophysiology: Necrotising small-vessel inflammation saddles noses, stridors airways and crescents kidneys; GPA granulomas mark c-ANCA PR3, EGPA eosinophils wheeze through asthma to cardiac neuropathy, MPA bleeds lungs and kidneys with p-ANCA, and IgA vasculitis purpuras young legs and guts.
additionalDifferentials: Goodpasture versus cryoglobulinaemia versus HSP versus paraneoplastic by GBM hep-C IgA and age
GPA versus EGPA versus MPA by granuloma asthma eosinophils and PR3-MPO
Vasculitis versus SLE versus endocarditis by ANCA dsDNA and cultures
additionalInvestigations: c-ANCA PR3 p-ANCA MPO with eosinophils
Pauci-immune biopsy with urine casts creatinine
Chest sinus scans with IgA screens
